title: AI;DR (AI; Didn't Read)
summary: This article explores the growing trend of people relying on AI-generated summaries instead of reading full content, using the clever acronym AI;DR (AI; Didn't Read) as a play on the traditional TL;DR. It examines the cultural and cognitive implications of how AI tools are reshaping our information consumption habits.
problem_solved: Addresses the cultural shift toward preferring AI summaries over original content reading.
why_valuable: It sparks an important conversation about attention economy and critical thinking in an AI-assisted information age.
